limitations: Bounded explicit Vietnamese and accentless predicates only; unseen vocabulary and implicit aspects can be missed.
Negation handles a local window of at most three intervening modifiers; long scope, double negation, questions, modality and sarcasm are not resolved.
Paired quotations and explicit metalinguistic prefixes are suppressed; indirect reported speech is not generally resolved.
Accentless thay/co, pronoun reference, ambiguous subjects and education versus outside-domain meanings remain ambiguous.
Clause boundaries use punctuation and explicit contrast, plus coordinating va only before an explicit subject after a predicate; no syntactic parser.
CT4 clause outputs are audit-only multiclass observations, never evidence of mixed or a second core topic.
No independent human-reviewed multilabel evaluation exists; no accuracy improvement or full negation solution is claimed.
